verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents region or data-residency selection for the hosted Firecrawl cloud. The only path to controlling where data lives is implied: Firecrawl is AGPL-3.0 open source and can be self-hosted, though the cloud version has additional features the self-hosted one lacks. Missing for 10: documented region/residency selection in the hosted service, explicit data-storage location or retention controls, independent confirmation that self-hosting meets residency needs.
